response:
Folks, take a good hard look at the breakdown of law and order happening right before our eyes. This is the inevitable fruit of progressive ideology eroding our culture and breeding total disrespect for authority and public order. Look at what happened when radical agitators held their "No Kings" rally in the public square—it brought complete chaos and an abandonment of personal responsibility.

Hardworking citizens and traditional families rely on civic peace, but these mobs packed the streets and brazenly squared off with the authorities. Thank God for the federal officers and police who stood their ground to restore order, deploying tear gas and making at least 13 arrests confirmed in Portland, Denver and... because when you let radical elements defy lawful orders to disperse and try to tear down our foundational institutions, civilization itself is put on the line. We must back the blue, protect our shared traditions, and put a permanent stop to this madness.
